core_obligations: Vanishing: $R^i f_{QCoh,*}\mathcal{F} = 0$ for $i > 0$ and any $\mathcal{F}$ in $\mathit{QCoh}^{fbc}(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{X})$, by the cited affine case (proof lines 2717-2719).
Exactness: $f_{QCoh,*}$ is exact as its derived functors form a delta-functor with $R^i = 0$ for $i > 0$ (proof lines 2721-2723, using the delivered delta-functor structure).

Colimits: $f_{QCoh,*}(\bigoplus \mathcal{F}_i) = \bigoplus f_{QCoh,*}\mathcal{F}_i$ by the cited direct-sums lemma; all small colimits follow since exactness plus direct sums yields arbitrary colimits (proof lines 2725-2727).
proof_roadmap: Direct sums from the cited lemma; general colimits from exactness plus direct sums.
difficulty_reason: Four-step inference chain, each step explicit: (1) vanishing of higher direct images from the affine case lemma; (2) exactness of f_{QCoh,*} because its derived functors form a delta-functor with vanishing positive terms (delivered earlier in this chapter); (3) direct sums commute by the cited direct-sums lemma; (4) all colimits commute since exact + direct sums gives all finite colimits and filtered colimits.
